sources.facts: The producer separates Sikory, Family Reserve, Family Heritage, On Terraces and sparkling wines. The catalog also lists late-harvest wines. Old and current label generations are not merged.

The producer describes grapes from selected plots and three years of bottle aging for the 2020 release. This supports editorial special-collection positioning; its vintage and composition do not replace saved metadata.
The card identifies white extra brut, Riesling and the sparkling category. It remains separate from saved dry and sweet still Riesling wines.
